runtime.execution: Rust multi-crate Tokio/ReAct core; typed tools; CLI/TUI/web surfaces; selected reqwest or curl transport
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local shell groups, background children, session/team/mailbox files; consumes model/MCP services. Current pinned core is Rust despite Python-family registry label.

summary: Rust migrated coding agent with schema deferral, custom executable tools, staged compaction and genuine asynchronous multi-model teammates; custody and history boundaries need scrutiny.

inspection.scope: Primary CLI entry, loop/provider transport, default and team tool registration, dispatch, shell process/drop paths, subagent creation/resume, mailbox and sender state, compaction/session events/debug, skill/MCP changes and relevant tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Optional browser/LSP and other unregistered implementation modules not promoted into exposed capabilities; schedule executor consumer not traced. Source faults are inferred, not executed. TUI/web behavior not exhaustively traced.

actions.name: Read / Glob / Grep
actions.authority: Model through default registry; host filesystem and sanitizer.

actions.name: Write / Edit
actions.lifecycle: awaited writes block interruption per tool declaration; outer dispatcher still selective
actions.authority: Model; sensitive paths refused by tools.

actions.name: Bash
actions.output: output/exit data or background ID/PID metadata
actions.lifecycle: foreground awaited; background process stored; no model-native poll/kill verbs in Bash schema
actions.authority: Model; approvals may be disabled, dangerous-command patterns still refused.

actions.name: NotebookEdit
actions.lifecycle: synchronous file edit, no execution session

actions.name: memory
actions.input: read/write/search/list, file/content/query, project/global scope and match mode
actions.authority: Model; owned file state, not external general DB.

actions.name: CronCreate
actions.lifecycle: JSON standing-job declarations; actual executor consumer not inspected
actions.authority: Model default registered; schedule metadata only is traced.

actions.name: Agent
actions.output: child text/stats and task ID; optional immediate background response
actions.lifecycle: isolated new child loop; ID reuse labelled resume but no saved history load in this path
actions.authority: Model; per-agent tool policy; prevent background-in-background spawn.

actions.name: TeamCreate / TeamDelete
actions.lifecycle: TeamCreate idle registration; TeamDelete implementation not deeply traced

actions.name: SpawnTeammate
actions.output: task ID and asynchronous completion event
actions.lifecycle: Tokio task; child context/mailbox; worktree failure shared fallback
actions.authority: Model; shared registry and independently chosen child model.

actions.name: SendMessage / CheckMailbox
actions.lifecycle: file-backed send; receive marks read; automatic drain only at startup
actions.authority: Model; caller-supplied mailbox identity and hardcoded leader sender lack custody-bound identity.

actions.name: TeamAddTask / TeamListTasks / TeamClaimTask / TeamCompleteTask
actions.output: shared task states and claim results
actions.lifecycle: task-list operations, claim checks readiness; no forced execution orchestration implied
actions.authority: Model; claimed_by supplied or constructor name.

actions.name: TodoWrite / TaskUpdate / TaskList / TaskStop / EnterPlanMode
actions.input: todo/task fields and plan mode requests
actions.lifecycle: default tools; dispatcher special-cases TaskStop as noninterruptible
actions.authority: Model; only registration/control exception traced in depth.

actions.name: AskUserQuestion / WebFetch / WebSearch
actions.lifecycle: default registered; individual network/question executors not deeply traced
actions.authority: Model native catalog; implementation limits disclosed.

actions.name: ToolSearch / Skill
actions.output: activated schemas/loaded prompt and optional model override
actions.lifecycle: tool deferral per loop; skill cache invalidates next load

actions.name: custom command manifests (.opendev/tools, .opencode/tool)
actions.lifecycle: construction discovery; command timeout, no proved process cleanup on dropped future
actions.authority: Program/operator supplies executable; model calls registered schemas.

actions.name: MCP bridge discovery
actions.output: native registry tools and Skill prompt additions
actions.lifecycle: asynchronous runtime initialization; live registry mutation

actions.name: query / compact / resume session
actions.input: prompt/current session; compact; stored session selection
actions.lifecycle: loop then current-session persistence; compaction/pre_count mismatch; saved data resume, no active-work continuity

actions.name: EventStore / debug logger
actions.input: normalized session events; optional normalized payload debug calls
actions.output: sequenced JSONL events or debug lines
actions.lifecycle: best-effort writes, current session is primary; no complete capture guarantee
actions.authority: Runtime internal, not native model audit query.

filesystem.detail: Default native file/search/edit operations and shell; sensitive-path tool checks remain with approvals off.

processes.detail: Foreground group cleanup exists, but outer cancellation drops future before inner cleanup; background stored buffers are stale clones and no Bash poll/kill verbs. Custom commands lack kill-on-drop.

code_actions.detail: Bash and custom JSON-stdin executable tools; notebook tool edits files only. Read-only heuristic even accepts cargo test/build-script-capable commands.

persistent_kernel.detail: No notebook execution/kernel transport in inspected default tool/runtime paths.

standing_database.detail: Owned memory files/session events/team state and JSON schedules; general shared DB client/table action not established.

workflow_programming.detail: Agent specifications, custom tools, skills and shared task dependency claims compose workflows; ReAct loop remains compiled fixed program.

multi_model.detail: Subagent/teammate model override and spec-specific model selection before parent fallback.

live_collaboration.detail: Real running colleagues share file-backed messages, but sender is always leader and mailbox argument not custody-bound. Automatic drain occurs only before run, not per decision.

concurrent_work.detail: Early read-only-classified tools overlap provider streaming; background Bash/agents and teammate Tokio tasks; effect-free classification not guaranteed.

steering_interrupt.detail: Cancellation reaches reqwest and tool context but outer select drops futures; nonstreaming curl and summary omit cancellation, foreground cleanup may be bypassed.

turn_redefinition.detail: Model can invoke skills changing next prompt/model and ToolSearch schema activation; compiled loop not model-defined full turn.

compaction.detail: Automatic staged masking/pruning/summary mutates effective messages; CLI persistence slices with stale pre_count. Manual compaction destructive current-session replacement.

context_repair.detail: Primary CLI append events may retain previous normalized messages, but no model original-audit repair action; child advertised resume is fresh messages with reused ID.

original_audit.detail: Primary CLI wires sequenced normalized EventStore, but best-effort, events incomplete and saved after query; optional debug normalized payloads pre-adapter, outputs clipped before middleware.

audit_query.detail: EventStore and saved sessions provide local study primitives; model memory/file tools do not expose complete structured audit query.

hot_change.detail: Skills reload at next access and MCP mutates registry asynchronously; no default whole-turn/affected-workflow activation transaction.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Primary saved session resume is data restoration; child resume reuses ID without history; no refit with own provider/process quiescence and external outpost.

remote_services.detail: Adapted provider clients and MCP bridges consume remote services; own shared-fabric governance not implied.

self_improvement.detail: File/program/skill tools allow modifications; no governed harness autoresearch and reinhabitation lifecycle traced.

complaints.detail: No state-rich model complaint/bead operation in default native registry/team/loop paths.

authority.detail: Approvals can be disabled, tools still refuse patterns/sensitive paths; mailbox sender/name and task claimed_by are labels supplied without actor binding.

evaluation.detail: Native source tests for filesystem/shell/classification/mailboxes/compaction; key lifecycle and cross-layer compaction assertions absent from inspected oracles.

time_order.detail: Event sequence and task/provider IDs exist; clipped/best-effort capture and detached process/colleague tasks do not establish total causal audit/custody.

evidence.claim: Pinned OpenDev is Rust migration, edition 2024/version 0.1.9; group label does not establish Python implementation.
Primary CLI wires EventStore and saved-session resume.
Default exposed tools; implementation modules alone are not evidence of registration.
Registers agent/team/mailbox/task-list/ToolSearch tools.
ReAct iteration, collector/context/schema preparation, model response and dispatch continuation.
Builds normalized payload, applies skill override, conditional debug logging and adapted provider stream/request.
Provider request/response adapters and nonstreaming curl path with no cancellation token or kill-on-drop.
reqwest request races cancellation with unique request ID; response body reading is a later phase.
Early read-only-classified tool tasks spawned during provider stream with child token/semaphore.
Outer cancellation select drops ordinary registry future; TaskStop/task_complete exceptions; result projects output/error.
Shell group, output reader tasks and inner cancellation/timeout group cleanup; spawned child lacks kill_on_drop.
Background handle stores clones of early output vectors while detached readers continue into separate Arc buffers.
Bash schema command/deadlines/background/workdir, unconditional dangerous-command block, auto-background and truncation.
Custom subprocess receives JSON stdin and wait_with_output under timeout; no group/kill-on-drop path here.
Discovers custom command manifests at runtime construction.
Read schema, concurrency classification and bounded filesystem read dispatch.
Write schema and host path resolution; sensitive-file refusals even under autoapproval.
Edit schema, fuzzy replacement and sensitive-file gating.
Agent task_id only reuses saved ID, manager.spawn fresh run; output says resume but never loads prior child messages here.
Child model selection explicit override then spec then parent.
Child context/tool registry and newly built messages delegated to runner; mailbox and cancellation passed.
TeamCreate registers idle metadata/members, does not launch colleagues.
SendMessage selects team/target and labels all messages sender leader.
Real independently spawned colleague with optional model/worktree and mailbox; failed worktree creation falls back to shared workdir.
Mailbox is automatically drained only before ReAct; continuing colleague must call CheckMailbox.
CheckMailbox optional agent_name selects identity; receives and marks read.
File-backed inbox, send/receive/peek/poll and corrupt-file preservation/reset.
TeamClaimTask trusts claimed_by argument then claims task with dependency/state checks.
Threshold-based in-place context masking/pruning/summary; summary call has no cancellation token.
pre_count before loop is reused to slice compacted result.messages; source permits wrong persistence or out-of-bounds panic.
Manual compaction replaces session messages then saves.
Normalized session/message/file events, not exhaustive provider/stream/action event vocabulary.
JSONL sequence envelope append.
Normalized message event on add and atomic current JSON session save.
Event store append failure warns rather than failing operation; JSON session remains primary.
Optional full normalized payload debug logging; append write errors ignored.
Native memory read/write/search/list file abstraction and scopes; not SQL.
CronCreate persists JSON schedule entries and CRUD; scheduler consumer not traced.
NotebookEdit manipulates ipynb cells, no kernel execution.
Skill mtime cache invalidation on next load.
MCP connection discovery mutates shared registry and Skill prompts asynchronously.
Headless/skip approvals disables approval layer, not native sensitive-path/command checks.
Overflow files themselves clip beyond hard maximum, so not original capture.
Sanitizer runs before after middleware/cache and returned result.
Process-group cleanup test calls helper but has no postkill process-death oracle.
Five writer threads and count=5 oracle; does not check identities/content uniqueness.
Compaction oracle only shorter messages/first system/summary marker.
Read-only heuristic accepts cargo test/clippy/check, which may execute build scripts/tests and write outputs.

tests.oracle: Cleanup test invokes helper without proving descendant death; cargo test classified read-only is asserted but arbitrary test effects not ruled out.
Five writer threads and received-count oracle; identity uniqueness, sender binding and in-loop colleague delivery untested.
Checks shorter vector/system/summary marker, not stale CLI pre_count indexing or original audit repair.

strengths: Model-selected real asynchronous teammates and inbox/task primitives, distinct from simulated colleague sampling.
Native tool schema deferral and custom JSON-stdin executable extension.
Sequenced sidecar event format is a useful partial audit primitive with visible failure semantics.
limits: Optional browser/LSP and other unregistered implementation modules not promoted into exposed capabilities; schedule executor consumer not traced. Source faults are inferred, not executed. TUI/web behavior not exhaustively traced.
arconaut_questions: Can child cancellation own cleanup rather than race/drop the cleanup future?
Can live messages bind authenticated actor identity and delivery checkpoints rather than constructor labels?
Can compaction/persistence use message identities and projection events rather than length offsets?
Can context repair and executable refit be designed independently of current JSON chat save?
